purpose: Full backend regression selection used by the PostgreSQL CI job, plus independent controls. Local, synthetic, provider-blocked.

evidence.runtime: Tier 3 for local authenticated API and SQL assertions. Tier 2 for rule and model-mock tests.
evidence.sensitivity: Booking fixture S2: the previous implementation produced 20 setup errors. The repaired fixture passes under the same block on shared port 5432. The payments boundary now uses positive and negative trip IDs for two real test JWTs. No physical-device or hosted release evidence.

environment.postgres_role: Non-superuser, NOBYPASSRLS, owns only synthetic test databases. Same tests use a newly cloned and migrated ephemeral database per pytest session.
environment.storage: Isolated checkout snapshot, SQL and file test writes outside the working tree. macOS Seatbelt permitted writes only inside the temporary test root and permitted network connections only to its private PostgreSQL listener. Shared API 8000 and PostgreSQL 5432 were denied.
environment.environment_keys: Credentials stripped. Synthetic CI signing keys and agency ID. Hybrid decision engine enabled. Zero spending cap on broad tests; additional mock-only controls remove that cap while OS network restrictions remain. No provider or account mutations.
environment.runner_selection: The latest full sweep partitions the same CI-selected test names into two non-overlapping pytest invocations. The main shard deselects exactly three mock-only hybrid tests; the second runs those exact three with their own environment. Test names are retained in the raw receipts.

timing_note: Concurrent work changed the collected test set and route count during this audit. Compare named failures and controls across phases. An earlier uncapped broad attempt was stopped after 13 tests in 256.56s because model SDK retry backoff ran against OS-denied sockets.

known_failure_diagnoses.three_model_mock_tests: The spending cap blocks even an injected mock before its synthetic response is returned. All three pass in the no-cap control with network still blocked.
known_failure_diagnoses.two_db_refresh_errors: The original 40-connection cap on the isolated PostgreSQL server was exhausted in the broad concurrent-connection test mix. Increasing to 130 in that disposable cluster made both tests pass in full; the independent control also passed.
known_failure_diagnoses.historical_audit_filters: Two older audit-filter tests stub TripStore.list_trips where the router uses list_trip_summaries. Earlier repository evidence: Docs/research/AGENTIC_EVAL_ROUTING_HEALTH_OPERATOR_CONTRACT_2026-07-01.md. Fixed in the two corresponding tests. Positive trip and negative foreign-trip assertions are covered.
known_failure_diagnoses.holiday_clock: A 2026-11-08 assertion ran against the date 2026-11-25; the extraction selected the next Diwali date 2027-10-29 from its registry. Fixed by controlling the reference date and independently asserting both same-year and following-year results.
known_failure_diagnoses.messaging_routes: Route/OpenAPI snapshots had 437/397 versus 442/402 after concurrently added messaging/supplier routes. The BFF gap detector compared the literal strings {id} and {conversation_id}. The route owner refreshed both snapshots. The BFF regression test now compares the precise backend template rather than a subset of text.
known_failure_diagnoses.draft_warm_cache: Hybrid visa reasoning from prior runs was persisted to data/decision_cache/visa_timeline_risk.json. Updated rule wording alone left four fixture failures on warm identical inputs. The old cache was preserved; the same tests passed cold. The final cache-key/rule implementation passes on that same seeded legacy cache, including applied/waived/absent-destination controls and queued reassessment.
known_failure_diagnoses.messaging_inbound_fixtures: Three newly written messaging tests failed the real dogfood plaintext privacy guard when their initial fixture forced file storage. The next fixture revision requests SQL/beta. See later verification. The revised inbound-to-inbox contract and the full local flow are green in the final sweep.
known_failure_diagnoses.migration_glob: On HFS+ the first matching audit migration was add_audit_chain_hash; selecting it did not test creation. Fixed stable revision lookup and verified the create-table operation.

storage_recovery.impact: A later retry on primary APFS exhausted allocatable storage. PostgreSQL reported ENOSPC while creating or extending its disposable test database, then reported an invalid test template. This attempt is excluded from the product failure counts.
storage_recovery.recovery: Moved only the task-owned test repository, cache and database to a new local RAM volume. Preserved the pre-fix cache and initialized a fresh disposable PostgreSQL database with the same restricted test role. Rechecked sandbox permissions for 55673 (permitted), 5432, 8000 and 443 (denied).
storage_recovery.final: Local suite completed on the RAM filesystem with no ENOSPC. The disposable PostgreSQL process was shut down after verification.
